patches_modified.name: Block Trackers
patches_modified.description: Blocks crash reporting, ad attribution and referral tracking.

patches_modified.name: Remove Extra Files
patches_modified.description: Deletes tutorial videos, editor stickers and junk to shrink the app.

patches_modified.name: Stop Background Sync
patches_modified.description: Stops background sync tasks and alarms that drain the battery.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Pro
patches_modified.description: Unlocks Pro features stored on the device (routines, folders, charts). Server-limited items may still need a subscription.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Google AppMeasurement, AppsFlyer, and ByteDance AppLog event dispatchers.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Effects Region Restriction
patches_modified.description: Fixes effects, transitions, and templates failing to load (ByteDance Shark WAF block) by spoofing device_platform to 'windows' and resetting deviceId in effect requests.

patches_modified.name: Bypass GeoBlock Region Restriction
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut GeoBlock config lists (cert, dock, entrance, page, scheme) to empty so region-blocked surfaces stay enabled. Server-refused content may still fail to load.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Signature Check
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the official APK signature (SHA-256) for tamper telemetry, drops the server-driven signature blacklist, silences the abnormal-source toast, and disables the Godzilla inject-detect gate so re-signed builds are not blocked.

patches_modified.name: Bypass Unsafe Package Modal
patches_modified.description: Replaces the unsafe-package modal fallback URL in the Lynx schema defaults with the real template portal URL so region-blocked or untrusted-client fallbacks open templates instead of the blocking security notice.

patches_modified.name: Locale Assets Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips unselected CapCut asset locale bundles (assets/locales/*.json) from the APK. English is always preserved. For res/values-* string tables use the canonical universal Remove Extra Languages patch.

patches_modified.name: Native Bloat Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Strips non-essential companion native libraries by zeroing bytes in-situ. Always zeroes AppLovin ad crash reporter. WARNING: Stripping speech recognition and synthesis engines (libspeech*.so) disables voice recognition, voiceover captions, and speech-to-text features.

patches_modified.name: Remove Watermark
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut watermark-removal gates to allow export without watermark (WatermarkBusinessFunction).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut VIP gates to return true (SubscribeImpl, PayVipImpl, UserVipInfo, UserDetailInfo, VipUserServiceImpl, SubscribeCloudImpl) plus central account status flags (BusinessManager). Cloud-gated assets may still fail.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium Templates
patches_modified.description: Marks premium template styles as available so locked template features stay usable.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Ultra HD Export
patches_modified.description: Forces CapCut Ultra HD / high-resolution export gates to unlocked so 4K export options stay available.

patches_modified.name: Background Slimmer
patches_modified.description: Disables background periodic jobs, home screen widgets, and companion services to reduce resource usage.

patches_modified.name: Block Telemetry & Trackers
patches_modified.description: Blocks tracking services, analytics collection, and advertising identifiers, redirects Braze and Sentry endpoints to 0.0.0.0, and purges Sentry manifest metadata.

patches_added.name: Anonymous chat
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that opens Kick's chat as a guest, the way Kick opens it when you're signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in: the chat page gets neither your sign-in token nor your account's name and ID, so its own connection to Kick's chat isn't yours. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on, and messages that mention you aren't highlighted. Kick can still tell that you are watching: the player's playback request (postPlayerTelemetry) and the app's own live connection still identify you. Checked signed out only; whether Kick then leaves you off a channel's chatter list needs an account to see. The switch applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat. Like every patch that changes Kick's JavaScript, it turns off Kick's over-the-air JavaScript updates, so Kick's code fixes arrive only when you patch a newer version.

patches_added.name: Mute stitched live ads
patches_added.description: Experimental: ads could not be observed signed out. While Kick's player reports an ad break stitched into a live stream, mutes the player and covers the video with black and a small "Ad break", then restores both when the break's time is up, it ends, or another stream loads. The ad still plays for its full length and can't be skipped; this only silences and hides it. It acts on the ad signals Kick's player can get: an ad cue or ad break from Amazon IVS, or an ad of a MediaTailor session, which Kick only starts with Disable analytics off. None arrived in signed-out sessions, so this was checked only with made-up ad signals fed to Kick's own player code. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Show video stats
patches_added.description: Shows a small panel in the corner of the player with what Kick's video player reports, refreshed every second: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate and the network estimate, buffer, dropped frames, quality and codecs. The numbers come from the player on your phone; nothing is sent anywhere, and the panel never takes a tap. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Chat timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows the time next to each chat message, in 24-hour (13:05) or 12-hour (1:05) format as on Twitch. Kick's own chat settings can show times for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Shows the time next to each chat message. Kick's own chat settings have the same option for signed-in accounts; this one also works signed out and, while on, wins over Kick's. Kick's chat page draws the times, so a change to that page can stop it. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Turns the dark grey of Rumble's raised surfaces (the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags) pure black for OLED screens, optionally near-black so their edges still show. Rumble's dark theme already draws pages, sheets and dialogs black; dividers and buttons keep their grey. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: AMOLED black
patches_added.description: Turns the dark theme's greys black on screens drawn with Android views: the window and navigation bar, Home, Browse and channel pages, the theatre and chat, whose backgrounds are repainted after each layout. Screens Twitch draws with Compose (parts of settings, the emote picker and some sheets) and pop-up sheets keep their dark grey. Only in Twitch's dark mode. Applies after a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Interface.

patches_added.name: Auto-claim Drops
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that claims a Drop for your account as soon as Twitch's drops notification in a channel shows it as claimable, by pressing that notification's Claim button for you: the same claim request and the same "claim" analytics event a tap sends (Disable analytics blocks the event). Each drop is claimed once per app start. Needs a signed-in account and the notification, which shows while you watch a channel with Drops; drops earned elsewhere stay in your inventory. Checked against Twitch's code on Android's runtime, not yet with a real account. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Clip download
patches_added.description: Adds "Download clip" to the menu (⋮) of a clip in Twitch's clips feed, where clip links open. It asks gql.twitch.tv for the clip's video addresses and signed access token with the app's Client-ID only (no account), and Android's download manager saves the best quality as an MP4 in Downloads/Twitch. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Compact chat
patches_added.description: Adds switches that leave chatters' badges out of native chat lines (Twitch's and third-party ones) and show emotes as their text, so no emote images load. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; React Native chat is unchanged. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Force landscape
patches_added.description: Turns the screen to landscape when a live stream or video opens in Twitch's native theatre, and back to the orientation the app had when the theatre closes. Twitch's rotate button still switches to portrait. Home's feed previews don't rotate. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_added.name: Highlight first-time chatters
patches_added.description: Tints a chatter's first message in a channel in native live chat, using the first-msg tag Twitch's chat server puts on it. Chat history, VOD replay and React Native chat carry no such tag. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.

patches_added.name: Latency badge
patches_added.description: Shows how far a live stream plays behind the broadcast on Twitch's native player in the theatre, read from the player itself once a second (the latency the stats panel reports). Tapping it reloads the stream through Twitch's own Retry, a new access token and playlist that start at the live edge: the native player has no seek to live. Feed previews, videos and clips show nothing. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Default video quality
patches_modified.description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback. A lower rendition for metered networks (mobile data, or Wi-Fi marked as metered) can be chosen in Lurk settings > Playback > On mobile data; it's the same as on Wi-Fi until then.
patches_modified.previous_description: Starts playback at the selected rendition when available, with Source as the default. Saved player choices, including Auto, take priority. Unavailable renditions use Twitch's fallback.

patches_modified.name: Show video stats
patches_modified.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server, and for live streams the stream's uptime, from the stream age Twitch's playlist already carries. Everything shown is local to the player.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_modified.name: Third-party emotes
patches_modified.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. When on, each sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. "Emotes in the picker" also lists them in the emote picker, one section per service, and in autocomplete after ':', from the same lists; that part was checked with Twitch's own picker and autocomplete code on Android's runtime, not in the app, which needs an account to open the picker. Starts off. Turn it on in Lurk settings > Chat.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.
